description: Find sales leads: independent local businesses of one type in one place (for example plumbers in Leeds, dentists in Austin, cafes in Lisbon). For each business: name, address, phone numbers, emails, WhatsApp, social profiles and website, plus what its website is missing (no website at all, social page only, site down, not HTTPS, not mobile-friendly, no ad tracking, no analytics, no way to enquire, phone not tappable, no reviews, slow server). Leads with the most problems come first. Use page to get the next batch. Ideal for agencies, web designers and outreach agents. Costs 0.5 USDC per completed call, paid automatically via x402 if your client supports it. Never charged if the call fails.

include_no_website.description: Include businesses with no website (default true)

location.description: Town, city or area, e.g. "Leeds, UK"

only_with_issues.description: Only return businesses whose website has problems (default false)

name: find_leads
title: Find local business leads with contact details and website problems (paid)
